records.task: Follow the left thyroid lobe along its long axis and locate its connection to the isthmus.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The most vulnerable left long-axis contour improves from 14.98 to 2.33 mm. All five protected isthmus cuts agree within 0.75 mm.
scoreEvidence.form: Both lobes and the isthmus read in the front and reverse views. The bridge is smoother than r02. A slight ridge remains at the left shoulder where a stronger trial lost the grazing contour.
scoreEvidence.readability: At frame 48 the left lobe and its taper can be followed beside the carotid. Switching to the overlay identifies the lobe in the long-axis section. The bridge is clearer from the transverse entry.
scoreEvidence.economy: The selected surface preserves the five isthmus cuts and uses 5,900 triangles, down from 6,248. The worst turning-silhouette departure is 0.50 px.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
records.note: Bilateral long-axis exterior orientation. The historical four-axis bridge assessment remains on the original r01 export.

comparison.label: Historical thyroid and selected bilateral port
comparison.candidateLabel: The two lobes and the connecting isthmus remain visible. The left shoulder retains some local relief from the CT label.

views.label: Raw label and packed thyroid in front and reverse views
views.candidateLabel: The protected ridge follows the raw source near the grazing left section.

views.label: Right and left long-axis contour checks
views.candidateLabel: R03 recovers the left grazing contours while keeping the original frozen tolerance.

views.label: Both transverse acquisitions at frame 12
views.candidateLabel: The registered overlay places the same thyroid on both sides.

views.label: The five protected isthmus cuts
views.candidateLabel: The worst sagittal gap is 0.75 mm across the bridge.

views.label: The two longitudinal CT views at frame 48
views.candidateLabel: The worked cases retain their own frame-12 actions. Both CT companions load the same registered gland.

records.task: Follow the right thyroid lobe along its long axis and locate its connection to the isthmus.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The three right long-axis sections stay within 1.31 mm. Five independent sagittal cuts confirm that the source isthmus remains continuous.
scoreEvidence.form: Both lobes and the isthmus read in the front and reverse views. The bridge is smoother than r02. A slight ridge remains at the left shoulder where a stronger trial lost the grazing contour.
scoreEvidence.readability: The oblique and axial views distinguish the right lobe and the bridge. The long-axis overlay identifies the lobe under the probe at frame 48.
scoreEvidence.economy: The selected surface preserves the five isthmus cuts and uses 5,900 triangles, down from 6,248. The worst turning-silhouette departure is 0.50 px.
